text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you. I'm somewhat<n>surprised that you
actually<n>remembered.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Surprised? Who wouldn't remember<n>the birthday of
their good friend?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And as proof of my sincerity, I even<n>got you a
present.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But I wonder if you'll accept it. It<n>might not be good
enough for the<n>great King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Don't be silly. I would never think it<n>beneath me to
accept a gift from<n>someone so thoughtful toward
their<n>friends.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Go on, don't be shy now. I'll have<n>your present,
whatever it is!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, great. I really put a lot of effort into<n>this.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Here's one "Seiun Sky can tell King<n>what to do"
coupon!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hah, a homemade coupon is a real...<n>Wait.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why in the world would I have to dowhat you say?! That's justbackwards!
